card.name: Guragigna
card.tagline: Same as the Gurage dance - fast, full-body, acrobatic
card.profile: Guragigna is the dance of the Gurage people of Ethiopia, named after the Gurage language/people; it is the same tradition catalogued as 'Gurage dance.' Per Universal Tongue and the Mocha Ethiopia Dance Group, it features fast-paced, acrobatic, full-body movement - arms and legs swinging forward and back while jumping on alternate legs - performed at weddings, religious festivals and gatherings to masenqo and kebero. Women dance in trousers with hair covered to manage the rapid tempo.
card.insight: Guragigna showcases the Gurage's athletic dance style and is a lively expression of community identity within Ethiopia's diverse dance landscape (Universal Tongue; Mocha Ethiopia Dance Group).
card.image_significance: Gurage's lively footwork dance. A representative image shows drum-driven communal movement, often in a circle with vivid textiles — Gurage, Ethiopia.
